profile_text.body:
Databricks is a for-profit company founded in 2013 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its website describes it as a unified data and AI platform designed to run both analytical and operational workloads on a single open, governed foundation, covering ETL, data warehousing, business intelligence, and AI application development without requiring organizations to copy data across systems.

The company's AI offerings center on its Data + AI Platform and the open-source DBRX large language model, which uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture and is positioned for enterprise training use cases. Governance and data management are handled through Unity Catalog, while MLflow is cited for model governance. The platform includes Lakebase, described as a database that combines Postgres-style transactional workloads with lakehouse-scale analytics and governance, and Databricks Genie, a conversational analytics interface that allows business users to query enterprise data in plain language without SQL. Unity Gateway is presented as a multi-AI governance and cost control layer for managing access, spending, and observability across agents, models, and tools.

The site's held facts record 174 legal matters with California exposure but list no specific named cases. Databricks holds a tracked presence on theworldofai.org across two product categories, Chat and General LLMs and Data and Analytics AI, both tied to the DBRX model and the broader Lakehouse AI platform.
